title: JavaScript: Destructuring
description: Write a JavaScript program that uses array and object destructuring with spread/rest operators.
verificationTest: output.includes('First: red, Second: green') && output.includes('Rest: blue,yellow') && output.includes('Name: Alice, Age: 30') && output.includes('Combined: 1,2,3,4,5,6') && output.includes('Hello - Default Subtitle')

steps.title: Array destructuring
steps.description: Destructure an array [1, 2, 3] into variables a, b, c and print them.
hints: You can skip elements with commas

steps.title: Object destructuring
steps.description: Destructure an object {name: "Alice", age: 30} into variables name and age.

verification.failureMessage: Extract name and age from the object.
